scenario: [LTIM.4.1.1]: `Time - Time` is the exact `Duration` between them, and one above 2^63 - 1 ns raises a ComputationError of kind NOT_REPRESENTABLE ([LERR.1.4.10]). `P` holds the last instant (2^63 - 1 ns) as `a` and the first (-2^63 ns) as `b`, and rule `wide` renders `p.a - p.b`, almost 2^64 ns. Under a wrap the difference is -1 ns, which [RLOW.6.1.6]'s saturation turns into `0s`, logged silently. Rule `handler` logs each ComputationError's kind and rule ([LERR.9.1]). Message: `NOT_REPRESENTABLE wide`. PATH PINNED: libds's `Time - Time` arm in `rete/eval.c` (its `__builtin_sub_overflow` check, inside the lowering's `FN_MAX`); the Mercury runtime's `ds.eval.ltim_4_1_time_minus`.
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    id: Int key
    a: Time mutable
    b: Time mutable

rule wide:
    P p
->
    let d = (p.a - p.b)::String
    log info "wide {d}"

rule handler:
    ComputationError e
->
    log critical "{e.kind} {e.rule}"
